item.title: Ephesians 5:22-33
item.description:
Speaker: Rev. Jordan Senner | Series: Ephesians: God's Good Plan, God's New Humanity (Part 15) | Scripture: Ephesians 5:22–33

Rev. Jordan Senner unpacks Paul's vision of Christian marriage in Ephesians 5:22–33 as a living, embodied picture of Christ's sacrificial love for the church and the church's voluntary trust and devotion to Christ.
